economy.summary: His campaign says the district faces an affordability crisis, with energy prices, grocery bills, and housing costs rising; he proposes expanding energy capacity, supporting low-income assistance, expanding home repair programs, and cracking down on corporate home-buying.
economy.short: Proposes expanding energy, assistance, home repair; curbing corporate home-buying.

abortion.summary: His campaign says he will defend reproductive rights and keep the government out of patients' medical decisions.
abortion.short: Says he will defend reproductive rights, keep government out.

education.summary: His campaign says public dollars belong in public schools, and proposes raising teacher wages, investing in career and technical education, and keeping public funding from going to for-profit institutions.
education.short: Says public dollars belong in public schools; proposes higher teacher pay.

energy.summary: His campaign says he supports positioning Pennsylvania as a leader in clean energy industries and training workers, including veterans, for clean energy jobs.
energy.short: Supports clean energy leadership and clean energy workforce training.

guns.summary: His campaign's public safety platform focuses on funding first responders, including securing equipment for police departments, holding hearings on fire service funding, and helping EMS retain municipal funding; it does not state a firearms policy.
guns.short: Focuses on funding first responders; states no firearms policy.

economy.summary: She is a sponsor of the House Republicans' 'Freedom Through Affordability' initiative, which proposes a temporary cut to the state personal income tax rate, a suspension of the state gas tax and of gross receipts taxes on electricity and telecommunications, and sales tax holidays on baby products.
economy.short: Sponsors initiative proposing temporary income, gas, and utility tax cuts.

taxes.summary: She proposed temporarily removing the state sales tax on personal care items such as soap, shampoo, deodorant, and shaving cream, saying they are basic needs rather than luxuries.
taxes.short: Proposed removing sales tax on personal care essentials.

education.summary: She introduced legislation with Rep. Tim Hogan to create a pilot program aimed at training and supporting the next generation of early childhood educators.
education.short: Introduced legislation to train and support early childhood educators.

healthcare.summary: She co-sponsored House Bill 923, enacted as Act 49 of 2025, which extends a cost-of-living moratorium so seniors do not lose eligibility for the PACE and PACENET prescription drug programs; she said seniors should not be penalized by losing access to essential prescription programs.
healthcare.short: Co-sponsored enacted law protecting seniors' PACE prescription eligibility.
